works.body:
Good day! 
I would like to request an illustration with three characters in a cute romantic situation.

- Male Ritsuka Fujimaru
- Artoria Caster
- Artoria Avalon(A.A)

I would like the setting to be in a high school parody, using the uniforms in the link attached.
Give Caster and A.A leggings too under the skirt like Caster's in her ascensions.
Give A.A her red ribbons hanging from her hair, and also longer hair than Caster to make it clearer they are different.
I would like if you can put A.A's forehead emblem on her school vest and not on her forehead.

For the illustration I would like it if Ritsuka is sitting down on a bench with Artoria Caster laying her head on RItsuka's lap.
Artoria Avalon should be sitting next to Ritsuka, resting her head on his shoulder.
Both are taking a nap while holding one of Ritsuka's hands each.
I would like it to give the impression that the three are on a date enjoying a beautiful day, covered under the shadow of a tree.
